reviews.comment: SO KIND. She is so fun to be around and brings in demos almost EVERY DAY to help you visualize the units. Go to class, shes so sweet!

(Don't Panic) Checks attendance and mastery with Poll Everywhere for lecture quizzes but has a few makeup opportunities. Teaches material specifically with past exams or similar-difficulty questions. Grade depends on past exams, so know every single one in the back of your head. Very funny, human, and relatable when she isn't just lecturing.

Professor Bicer is an excellent professor, and I am very glad I took her class. She was always available for office hours and gave great feedback. However, the exams are weighted very heavily, so there is really not much room to mess up. Thankfully, she is very caring and does her best to ensure as many people understand as possible.

Just take a bunch of practice exams before each test and you'll be fine. She holds in class review sessions before each exam that often cover material very similar to what's on the test. Honestly didn't pay much attention in class and still ended up with a B (never bought nor read the textbook either lol).

Dr. Bicer was the best Physics professor I could have asked for last semester. She was incredibly caring and understanding, making sure absolutely everyone understood the content. She even tried to learn everyone's names. 206 is a hard class and reviewing is certainly needed, but Dr. Bicer presented the material in a very digestible manner

She teaches physics in a way that is understandable and truly wants her students to be successful in her class. She's super helpful during office hours and her lectures are very interesting and super important to do well in her class. Go over multiple past exams and ask her questions during office hours, I took her during summer 6-weeks dont panic.

Amazing professor with amazing TAs that will do their best to make sure you are as prepared as possible for the exams. As long as you understand calculus, none of the concepts are too hard. Tests can be stressful because they make up 90% of your grade, but spamming old exams and evaluating your mistakes pretty much guarantees you a passing grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Really great and understanding prof. Truly cared about her students (she will answer your email) and prepared us well for the common exams. She gave us a snack for the final exam. Unfortunately, her final was really difficult, but you should be fine if you're locked. I think she had a slight grade adjustment at the end to account for that.

Dr. Bicer is the most caring professor I've had. She's always happy to answer questions and loves when students show up to office hours. 207 is a hard class, especially if you've never taken physics before, but Dr. Bicer makes sure everyone understands the material. Don't Panic exams are worth 93% of your grade so make sure to start reviewing early
You can feel the motherly love. She cares about every single one of her students like they're her own kids. Also, her lectures were extremely engaging and helpful; don't skip them.

Please take her. She is extremely caring and kind. She had attendance that technically is not mandatory but... if you showed up almost everyday of class, she would curve your grade to the next letter (ie. 89-90). If you asked a question in class, she MADE sure you understood. She treated every one of her students as her children. Would recommend
She is the goat.

Great prof, she does a good job of explaining the material and is very approachable outside of class in you have questions/need help. She had review sessions before each exam, which were VERY helpful since the exam problems were similar to the review problems. Read the book, do the homework, go to office hours, and you'll get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She's super engaged in the class and will answer any questions asked. Test will be hard if you don't study but amazing prof.

If you took mechanics in high school this class will be mostly easy (the rotational stuff is taught differently so its a little weird). Bicer was really funny (sometimes unintentionally) but also really caring and a good lecturer. I would take her again. Don't take Don't Panic if you're not ready for your grade to be 93% exams.

PHYS206 Don't Panic is a hard class, but Dr. Bicer does an excellent job at explaining the material and walks through many questions that prepare you well for the exams, always ensuring everyone understands. She is extremely caring and accommodating and truly wants her students to do well. If you can, TAKE BICER.

Dr. Bicer is the best physics professor I have ever had. She made sure everyone understood the concepts as best as possible, and is very understanding of circumstances. Attend every lecture, as she is very thorough in her teaching and you will learn a lot.

Dr. Bicer is one of the nicest, most caring professors I've had. She memorized the name of every person in our huge lecture by the end of the semester. She knew my name even though I only talked to her once. 207 is pretty rough, but if someone is going to get you through it, it's her.

She's genuinely the best, most understanding and compassionate professor I've ever had. She's not judgemental in any way, and there really is no stupid questions to ask. She's extremely helpful and eager to help her students succeed, she would ask us every lecture if there was anything she could improve upon or anything she needed to go over again.

Dr. Bicer is an amazing professor who has a passion for her students. She has a light accent so it can be hard to understand her at times, but she loves her students and easily explains concepts. The recitations were kind of a drag but if you practice problems from the book and handouts, you will be just fine. Tests were 93% of the total grade :(
Tough class, but the mandatory lectures were always confusing and forced me to teach myself outside of class
Agree with the others. The class is difficult but she is really nice, teaches really well and gives amazing advice
agree with the others

Bicer was a very good teacher. She was a little new, but she definitely picked up steam over the course of the semester. She was very accessible both in and out of class, she posted tons of material and used lots of neat little demos to demonstrate concepts. I would highly recommend her as she does a great job with the toughness of Don't Panic.

She is an amazing professor that cares for her students. She makes sure that everyone understands the material and will always be open to help her students. Not saying this class will be easy as phys 207 is hard but she will make it easier to learn compared to other professors.

Professor Bicer is the sweetest and most caring professor! She learned names of students in the class which made the class more enjoyable. She records her lectures, brings visuals to class, and does her best to prepare you for the exams.

207 is a hard class no matter who you learn it from, but Dr. Bicer makes it as good as possible. I enjoyed her lectures. She has a non-American accent, but it wasn't ever a big problem for me. She is super, super nice. If you don't understand anything, she is happy to answer questions throughout the lecture. Demos at the beginning of units were fun
